When a turn carries several distinct answer texts, the longest is taken as the canonical answer; on this grid only one cell (v4-tools repair.t30) has more than one distinct text and it is undecidable either way, so the rule changes no verdict.

The accuracy line counts all four declared slots, so repair.t30's undecidable cells appear as undecidable in every arm; the per-headline restatements in docs/MATRIX-COVERAGE.md additionally show the 3-checkpoint config-C/V6 view with repair.t30 named as excluded, matching how those headlines were originally stated.
The 12 acc.* ids are acceptance checks, not checkpoints, and have no rows answers; they are outside the declared checkpoint cell space and are not counted in the 92.
